Kahte hain ki pratibha kisi bare shahar ya sansadhnon ki mohtaj nahin hoti hai. agar hunar ho aur use dikhane ka avsar mile to chhote shahron ki betiyan bhi bare parde par apni pahchan bana sakti hain. bhagalpur ki 14 sal ki kavya chaube iski ek misal bankar samne aaee hain.
